$comment: Skills, per design-bible §2. Only the M1 subset is defined so far; the remaining skills are listed in the design bible and get added as the systems behind them are built. Keys are permanent — they end up in the database.

skills.$comment: Ahead of the rest of the post-M1 list, because the opening needed it. crude_thruster was authored as the one thing players could not make, waiting on this skill, and the faction supply order that was supposed to sell it in the meantime was never built -- so the questline could not be finished at all (task 148). Everything is player-made, so the skill arrives rather than the exception staying.
skills.name: Electronics
